mapper.select: SELECT * FROM purchase_demand_calculation_batch WHERE id=#{batchId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT b.id AS batch_id, b.status, b.start_at, b.end_at, b.warehouse_id, w.name AS warehouse_name, b.supplier_id, s.name AS supplier_name, b.purchaser_id, e.actual_name AS purchaser_name, b.category_id, b.keyword, b.source_line_count, b.candidate_line_count, b.generated_count, b.skipped_count, b.created_at, b.created_by, b.generated_at FROM purchase_demand_calculation_batch b LEFT JOIN warehouse w ON w.id = b.warehouse_id AND w.deleted = FALSE LEFT JOIN supplier s ON s.id = b.supplier_id AND s.deleted = FALSE LEFT JOIN t_employee e ON e.employee_id = b.purchaser_id AND e.deleted_flag = FALSE WHERE b.id = #{batchId}
mapper.update: UPDATE purchase_demand_calculation_batch SET status='GENERATED', generated_count=#{generatedCount}, skipped_count=#{skippedCount}, result_snapshot=#{resultSnapshot,typeHandler=com.xsy.scm.purchase.support.PurchaseJsonbTypeHandler}, generated_at=#{generatedAt}, updated_at=#{generatedAt}, updated_by=#{operator} WHERE id=#{batchId} AND status='READY'
